title: Tractable
summary: TRACT'ABLE, adjective [Latin tractabilis, from tracto, to handle or lead.] 1. That may be easily led, taught or managed; docile; manageable; governable; as tractable children; a tractable learner. 2.

inlines.v: TRACT'ABLE, adjective [Latin tractabilis, from tracto, to handle or lead.] 1. That may be easily led, taught or managed; docile; manageable; governable; as tractable children; a tractable learner. 2. Palpable; such as may be handled; as tractable measures.
